info.note: Group split, Track 1 Step 3. Use video_to_split (SeaDronesSee) and seq_to_split (UAVDT) for detection and segmentation too, so no flight or sequence is in two splits across tracks.

uavdt.limitation: UAVDT was split by sequence, not by sequence prefix (M01..M14): with 14 prefix groups no assignment gave val and test each >= 5 truck and bus tracks with every class share within +-8% of 70/15/15. Sequences that share a prefix may come from the same flight or site, so val/test scores on UAVDT may be optimistic.
uavdt.frames: all 5 fps frames of a sequence belong to its split
